spider = a small animal with eight legs that makes webs
ant = a small insect that lives in large groups
worm = a long, thin animal that lives in soil
paw = the foot of an animal such as a dog or cat
fur = the thick hair that covers some animals
tail = the long part at the back of an animal
hibernate = to sleep through the winter
migrate = to travel to another place for part of the year
nature reserve = an area of land protected for plants and animals
national park = a large protected area of beautiful landscape
zoo = a place where wild animals are kept for people to see
safari = a trip to see wild animals in their natural habitat
compost = rotted plants used to make soil richer
landfill = a place where rubbish is buried in the ground
plastic = a light material used for bottles and bags; it lasts a long time
packaging = the paper, plastic or boxes around products
save energy = to use less electricity or gas
carbon footprint = the amount of greenhouse gas your life produces
deforestation = cutting down forests on a large scale
oil spill = when oil from a ship or well pollutes the sea
